name: @aegis-cc/feature-flags
description: Runtime-toggleable feature flags: boolean kill switches plus percentage-based rollouts, evaluated locally against Command Center's own database. Deliberately NOT a cross-system service -- Aegis owns an independent, mirrored equivalent for its own behaviors, so checking a flag never depends on the other system being reachable. See databases/postgres/migrations/0022_feature_flags.sql for the full reasoning.
